themes.name: THINKING
themes.question: Can a machine think?
themes.summary: Whether calculation, play, or composition by a machine counts as thought, or only imitates it.

themes.name: AUTOMATON
themes.question: Is the human being a machine?
themes.summary: Whether human action is fully determined by mechanism, and what is left of freedom if it is.

themes.name: LIFE
themes.question: What separates the living from the mechanical?
themes.summary: Whether organisms are complex machines or have a principle that no machine can have.

themes.name: JUDGMENT
themes.question: Should reasoning be handed to mechanical procedure?
themes.summary: Whether disputes can be settled by calculation, and what is lost when rules replace judgment.

themes.name: SUCCESSION
themes.question: Will machines evolve beyond humanity?
themes.summary: Whether machines will develop along their own line and displace the people who made them.

themes.name: TRANSCENDENCE
themes.question: Should humans use machines to overcome their limits?
themes.summary: Whether technology should be used to defeat death, the body, or human nature.

themes.name: LABOR
themes.question: Does machine work free the worker or degrade them?
themes.summary: Whether machinery relieves toil or reduces the worker to a part of the machine.

themes.name: HABIT
themes.question: Does a mechanized life make people mechanical?
themes.summary: Whether routine, speed, and the city turn people into automata.

themes.name: DEPENDENCE
themes.question: Does relying on machines weaken human capacities?
themes.summary: Whether tools that do our work leave us unable to do it ourselves.

themes.name: CONTROL
themes.question: Can people control what they make?
themes.summary: Whether a made thing can escape its maker, and who is responsible when it does.

themes.name: PERSONHOOD
themes.question: Do artificial beings have moral standing?
themes.summary: Whether a made being can be wronged, and whether using one is a kind of slavery.

themes.name: SACRED
themes.question: Is the machine divine, idolatrous, or providential?
themes.summary: Whether machines are objects of worship, instruments of God's plan, or false gods.

themes.name: CIVILIZATION
themes.question: Is machinery the measure of civilization?
themes.summary: Whether technical power shows that a people is advanced, or is a narrower thing than civilization.

themes.name: STATE
themes.question: Is society a machine, and should it be?
themes.summary: Whether governments and nations are mechanisms, and what happens to the people inside them.

themes.name: EXTENSION
themes.question: Are tools part of us or foreign to us?
themes.summary: Whether technology extends the human body and mind or stands against them.

themes.name: INTIMACY
themes.question: Can an artificial being be loved?
themes.summary: Whether love for a made being is real or a deception.

note: Theme membership of works now comes from data/stances.json via each theme's questions. The earlier per-theme seed lists are in data/archive/seed-works-v0.1.json.
